summary: This study tests a drug called aleniglipron for adults who have obesity or are overweight along with type 2 diabetes. The goal is to see how the treatment affects body weight over a long period. A placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the drug, will be compared against the study drug. The trial plans to include 1100 participants.
